fields.name: image_id
fields.description: COCO image id of the host image.

fields.name: image_filename
fields.description: Forged image in tampered/, e.g. '000000000074.png' (variants: '000000000074_v1.png').

fields.name: mask_filename
fields.description: Tri-map in masks/ (0=background, 128=source, 255=target).

fields.name: binary_mask_filename
fields.description: Binary forgery mask in binary_masks_flat/ (source+target=255).

fields.name: patch_labels_filename
fields.description: 16px patch-grid labels (.npy) in patch_labels/. -1=ignore boundary patches.

fields.name: hard_neg_filename
fields.description: Mask of non-source COCO objects (.npy) in hard_negatives/.

fields.name: soft_target_filename
fields.description: Optional soft (blurred) target mask in masks/soft_targets/.

fields.name: transform_policy
fields.description: Transform preset used (trans_only|trans_scale|coverage_like|full_aug).

fields.name: flip
fields.description: 1 if the copy was horizontally mirrored (never for text-bearing categories).

fields.name: blend_mode
fields.description: Compositing mode ('paste' = hard pixel copy).

fields.name: scale_factor
fields.description: Scaling multiplier applied to the copy (perspective-consistent).

fields.name: rotation_angle
fields.description: Rotation applied in degrees.

fields.name: source_bbox
fields.description: Bounding box of the original object (x, y, w, h).

fields.name: target_bbox
fields.description: Bounding box of the pasted object (x, y, w, h).

fields.name: source_ann_id
fields.description: COCO annotation id of the copied object.

fields.name: variant
fields.description: Variant tag ('_v0', '_v1', ...) — multiple forgeries per host image, each from a different source object.

fields.name: source_category_id
fields.description: COCO category id of the copied object.

fields.name: source_category_name
fields.description: COCO category name of the copied object.

fields.name: source_supercategory
fields.description: COCO supercategory of the copied object.

fields.name: placement_tier
fields.description: Candidate pool used: same_category|same_supercategory|vertical_band_fallback|no_candidates.

fields.name: horizon_tier
fields.description: Vertical constraint band accepted: strict|relaxed|permissive (permissive only for flying categories).

fields.name: same_cat_instance_count
fields.description: Number of same-category instances in the scene (hard-negative density).

fields.name: source_texture_var
fields.description: Laplacian variance of the source patch (texture richness).

fields.name: dest_texture_var
fields.description: Laplacian variance of the destination region.

fields.name: bg_similarity_score
fields.description: HSV histogram intersection between source and destination background rings.

fields.name: image_height
fields.description: Image height in pixels.

fields.name: image_width
fields.description: Image width in pixels.

fields.name: gate_profile
fields.description: Source-selection strictness that produced this row: 'strict' (main run), 'relaxed_v1' (edge 15→8px, isolation 5x5→3x3, fill 0.25→0.20), or 'relaxed_v2' (relaxed_v1 + min paste size 2%→1.2% of image area). Placement gates identical in all profiles. Filter to 'strict' for the most conservative subset.

fields.name: source_reused
fields.description: 1 if this sample re-pastes a source object that another sample from the same image already used (different destination, separate sample). Cap or drop repeats downstream if source-correlation matters.

fields.name: patch_hsv_applied
fields.description: 1 if a random HSV (S/V) shift was applied to the copy patch (Stage 2 only; always 0 in Stage 1).

fields.name: jpeg_quality
fields.description: JPEG quality of the final-image round-trip, null if not applied (Stage 2 only).

fields.name: noise_sigma
fields.description: Gaussian noise sigma applied to the final image, null if not applied (Stage 2 only).

fields.name: blur
fields.description: 1 if a 3x3 Gaussian blur was applied to the final image (Stage 2 only).

fields.name: contrast
fields.description: Contrast multiplier applied to the final image, null if not applied (Stage 2 only).

fields.name: brightness
fields.description: Brightness offset applied to the final image, null if not applied (Stage 2 only).
